title: Finite-presentation immersion model
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X$ and $S$ quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and with $f$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Fix a finite-stage datum $D$ of [def-nagata-relative-stage-morphism-data], whose existence under these hypotheses is [lemma-nagata-relative-stage-morphism-data-exists]. Write $\lambda_X,\lambda_S$ for its indices, $\varphi:X_{\lambda_X}\to S_{\lambda_S}$ for its descended morphism, and $p_X:X\to X_{\lambda_X}$, $p_S:S\to S_{\lambda_S}$ for the comparison projections recorded in this datum. Thus $\varphi\circ p_X=p_S\circ f$.

Define the finite-presentation immersion model to be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]
$$
Y^{\mathrm{imm}}(X/S)=X_{\lambda_X}\times_{S_{\lambda_S}}S,
$$
formed using $\varphi$ and $p_S$, with structure morphism $q:Y^{\mathrm{imm}}(X/S)\to S$ its second projection. Define $i^{\mathrm{imm}}:X\to Y^{\mathrm{imm}}(X/S)$ to be the universal morphism induced by the compatible pair $(p_X,f)$: its first projection is $p_X$ and its second projection is $f$. In particular $q\circ i^{\mathrm{imm}}=f$, so it is a morphism over $S$. The notation retains the fixed datum $D$ implicitly; no independence of that datum is asserted.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $S$ be qcqs and let $X\to S$ be locally of finite type with $X$
quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Choose a finite-stage datum from
[lemma-nagata-relative-stage-morphism-data-exists], including indices
$\lambda_X$ and $\lambda_S$ and the descended morphism
$\varphi_{\lambda_X,\lambda_S}$. Define

$$
Y^{\mathrm{imm}}(X/S)
=X_{\lambda_X}\times_{S_{\lambda_S}}S
$$

using $\varphi_{\lambda_X,\lambda_S}$ and the comparison map
$S\to S_{\lambda_S}$. The compatibility equality in the finite-stage
datum induces the map $i^{\mathrm{imm}}\colon X\to Y^{\mathrm{imm}}(X/S)$
over $S$.
